---
name: Feature Request
about: Suggest a new component, a new option, or a change in component behaviour
title: '[FEATURE] '
labels: enhancement
assignees: ''
---

## Problem
A clear description of the problem or limitation you are running into. Explain what you are trying to build and why the current library does not cover it.

## Proposed API / Component Behaviour
Describe the solution you would like to see. If possible, sketch the API:

```razor
<!-- Example of the markup you would like to write -->
<DataTable Items="items" EnableSelection="true" />
```

Describe the expected behaviour: default values, events raised, accessibility expectations, and how it should behave under Blazor Server and Blazor WebAssembly.

## Alternatives Considered
List any alternative solutions or workarounds you have considered, including custom code in your own project.

## Additional Context
Any other context, mockups, links to similar features in other libraries, or examples.
